question:
(i) Determine \(m\) so that the equation
\[
x^4-(3m+2)x^2+m^2=0
\]
has four real roots in arithmetic progression.

(ii) Let \(a\) and \(b\) be two real numbers. If the roots of the equation
\[
x^2-ax-b=0
\]
have absolute value less than one, show that each of the following conditions holds:
\[
\text{(i) }|b|<1,\qquad \text{(ii) }a+b<1,\qquad \text{(iii) }b-a<1.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
